intro: A pin shows a promotion first in every branch on the promo lists (the website's promos page). A hide takes it off those lists. Neither changes any price in search, compare or the basket.
search_placeholder: Promo text, product name, barcode or promotion id
search_hint: At least 2 characters, or a chain. Barcode: 7 digits or more.

coverage.none: Shown in no city: the promotion has no rows in force at live branches on the promo lists

check_city_hint: Pins and search results warn when a promotion is not shown in this city.

pin_form.title: Pin promotion
pin_form.sponsored_warning: Paid placement must be marked sponsored: the card then shows users the label "ממומן".
pin_form.confirm: Pin the promotion at position {{rank}}? Pins at that position and below move down one.
pin_form.confirm_sponsored: Pin the promotion at position {{rank}} as sponsored? Every user will see the label "ממומן".

hide_form.title: Hide promotion
hide_form.reason_placeholder: e.g. bad data from the chain
hide_form.pricing_note: A hide only takes the promotion off the promo lists. Its price in search, compare and the basket does not change.
hide_form.confirm: Hide the promotion from the promo lists?

list.remove_confirm: Remove this entry? The removal is recorded in the audit log.
list.sponsored_confirm: Mark as sponsored? Every user will see the label "ממומן".
list.expired_date: Expired: the end date has passed
list.expired_missing: Expired: the promotion is no longer in the data

errors.promo_not_found: The promotion is not in the current data
errors.already_curated: The promotion is already pinned or hidden
errors.pinned: The promotion is pinned: remove the pin before hiding it
errors.hidden: The promotion is hidden: remove the hide before pinning it
errors.invalid_dates: The end must be in the future and after the start
errors.query_required: Type at least 2 characters or choose a chain
